title: Mixed-Size 3D Analytical Placement with Heterogeneous Technology Nodes
problem: Mixed-size 3D placement for face-to-face stacked ICs with heterogeneous technology nodes requires efficient netlist partitioning and simultaneous optimization of macro positions, standard cell placement, and hybrid bonding terminal locations.
motivation: Heterogeneous 3D stacking with hybrid bonding enables improved chip density and performance, requiring specialized placement algorithms to handle multi-technology constraints.
method: The framework splits the circuit netlist into two stacked layers (dies) and simultaneously optimizes placement of large functional blocks (macros), millions of tiny cells, and the physical connection points (hybrid bonding terminals) between layers. It uses special scoring functions (objective functions) tailored to each manufacturing technology's constraints, along with density penalties that prevent overcrowding.
key_novelty: The core innovation is a scoring-and-penalty framework specifically designed for 3D placement of mixed-size components when dies use different manufacturing process nodes.
contributions: Multi-technology objective function for heterogeneous-node constraints
Multi-technology density penalty calculation for 3D placement
HBT-cell co-optimization with dedicated 3D objective function
Winning solution on ICCAD 2023 CAD Contest 3D Placement benchmark

metrics.other: Best results on ICCAD 2023 CAD Contest test cases
